author: F2F official
description: A 1950s council estate on the edge of the fens, traced from a real place. Defenders hold the top of Edinburgh Avenue; attackers start outside their house on Barnwell Road. A: the Green, by the Avenue Gap, the Green Gate up the garden paths or the SE Alley. B: the garage court, by the North Path, the West Path, the Avenue Path or the Back Gate from the ginnels.
name: Barnwell
